message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor about smoke alarms—she thought hers were just fine. I casually mentioned my recent experience with a faulty alarm that made me feel like a fool for ignoring the beeping. Turns out, she decided to check hers right after our chat and found out it was a bit too quiet for comfort! Sometimes those little nudges can save us from a potential headache. Have you ever had a moment like that where you felt a little smug about being prepared?
